screen.name: Name
screen.notKnownYet: Go.dot has not named this tablet yet
screen.foregroundRefused: Android refused to keep the link in the background: {problem}

tabs.cuesLater: The cue list comes in a later build.
tabs.runningLater: The running cues come in a later build.
tabs.surfaceLater: The surface comes in a later build.
tabs.mappingLater: The video mapping comes in a later build.
tabs.noMachine: No machine on screen: add one on the Machines tab.

machines.title: Machines
machines.none: No machine yet. Type the address of the computer running Go.dot below.
machines.taken: Another machine in the list has this address and port.
machines.removeText: Its link closes and it leaves the list. Nothing changes on the machine itself.
machines.tooOld: This Go.dot cannot stream its state to a remote: update it to a build with the remote.

tablet.title: This tablet
tablet.name: Its name
tablet.nameSaid: Go.dot shows this name in Show settings > Network.

find.title: Find this tablet
find.explain: Go.dot's Show settings > Network has a Find button for this tablet: its screen flashes, it sounds its alarm and vibrates until it is touched.
find.notificationsOff: Notifications are off for this app: Go.dot cannot find the tablet while the app is in the background.
find.overLockOff: Android does not let the alarm open over the lock screen: a locked tablet will sound and vibrate, without the flashing screen.
find.allowOverLock: Allow it over the lock screen
find.channelDescription: The alarm Go.dot sounds to find this tablet.
find.notificationText: Swipe it away to stop the alarm.

link.tooOld: this Go.dot is too old for the remote

refusal.noClock: Audio disconnected - cues paused; waiting for the interface and clock.
refusal.setMany: node.setMany refused: {reason} at {where} - none of its values was written
refusal.goTooSoon: GO ignored: too soon after the last one (Show settings > Playback)
refusal.dohTooLate: Doh! ignored: the last GO is too long ago to take back (Show settings > Playback)
refusal.dohNothing: Doh! ignored: there is no GO it can take back
refusal.dohTrigger: Doh! ignored: a trigger fired after the last GO
refusal.dohTooSoon: Doh! ignored: pressed again too soon (Show settings > Playback)
refusal.flagNothing: Nothing flagged: no GO has fired a cue yet
refusal.flagGone: Nothing flagged: the cue the last GO fired has been deleted

notification.channelDescription: Keeps this tablet linked to Go.dot while the app is in the background.

running.title: Running
running.notSent: Not sent: no machine is linked
running.hint: Tap a run for its actions · swipe it far either way to kill it
running.dragToSeek: Drag to move the playhead - above or below it for finer steps
running.pillsHint: Tap: skip this round · hold: skip until the group ends
running.over: Over: it leaves this list in a few seconds.
running.killWithMembers: Kill it and everything under it ({count}) - no footer

cues.notGoList: GO fires the GO list's standby, not this list's.
cues.parkOnlyGoList: Only the GO list's standby can be parked from here: make this the GO list first.
cues.noLists: This show has no cue list.
cues.fireNow: Fire now - the standby stays where it is

field.runTrim: Trim of the run playing now - tonight only

inspector.none: Tap a cue to see what the tablet can change on it.
inspector.lockedNote: The show's rows are greyed. EQ, sends, flags and trims still move.
inspector.liveCount: {count} changes ride live - not saved until the show is unlocked and they are kept
